threadDescriptions.fern-cover: Deliver a botanical cover illustration for Fern Quarterly
threadDescriptions.fern-invoice: Invoice and collect payment for the Fern Quarterly cover commission
threadDescriptions.portfolio-refresh: Refresh the illustrator's public portfolio with selected finished work
threadDescriptions.cat-sitter: Arrange cat care during an upcoming weekend away

items.text: Fern Quarterly cover brief: one fern curling around a teacup, cream background, space above for the masthead. First sketch due Tuesday.
Invoice draft FQ-18: cover illustration 420, payable within thirty days. Need the publisher's billing address before sending.
Portfolio front page feels crowded. Replace the old grid with six large images and a short commission enquiry link.
Cat sitter Mara can visit Saturday and Sunday. Send feeding amounts and show where the spare key lives.
Fern sketch feedback: cup handle should face left. Keep the leaf silhouette; editor liked the breathing room above it.
FQ-18 billing address received. Editorial contact and accounts contact differ; send the invoice to accounts with the approved fee attached.
Mara / cream / Tuesday
Fern editor correction: no teacup after all. Replace it with a plain seed envelope; retain the curled fern and cream field. Tuesday sketch deadline still stands.
items.rationale: Replaces original central object in the brief.

items.text: Portfolio image shortlist: harbour print, winter orchard, moth study. The new six-slot layout needs a mix of editorial and personal work.
Rename the Fern cover folder to Spring seed cover. This is still the same Quarterly commission, following the teacup-to-envelope brief change.
items.rationale: Explicit rename of existing cover work.

items.text: Cat-care sheet: half a pouch each morning, dry food after the evening visit. Mara tested the key; it sticks unless lifted slightly.
Spring seed cover approved. Export the print TIFF at the editor's dimensions and send the signed approval to accounts so invoice FQ-18 can be released today.
items.rationale: Art delivery and invoicing are both actionable.

items.text: Portfolio contact button is unreadable on the moth thumbnail. Move the enquiry link beneath the image grid.
FQ-18 sent for 420; thirty-day due date entered in the ledger. Do not count editor approval as payment received.
Cover export check: tiny white seam at the seed envelope edge. Re-export the print file and replace the proof attachment.
Fern art can appear in my portfolio only after the issue launches. Schedule the Spring seed thumbnail for that date and retain the editor's permission email.
items.rationale: Portfolio publication timing; does not request new cover work.

items.text: The one on the left is approved. Send when ready.
Mara's Sunday cat photo: bowl refilled and key returned through the letter slot. Pay her for both visits.
Accounts remittance names FQ-18, amount 420. Matched it to the bank entry; the cover invoice is settled.
Six-image portfolio live. Tested the enquiry link on a phone; the Spring seed slot stays unpublished until the issue date.

undo.reason: Hypothetical correction: this schedules reuse in a portfolio and does not advance the completed illustration deliverable.
